response.justification: The candidate has extensive experience in software development but lacks direct experience with C++ at the mid-senior level required for this role. Their expertise is primarily in Node.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, and other languages, with only limited early-career exposure to C++. Additionally, there is no clear evidence of work with industrial automation, IoT, or cybersecurity standards like IEC 62443, which are core to this position.
strengths: Strong full-stack development experience with diverse technologies (Node.js, TypeScript, React, etc.)
Proven leadership and mentorship in software development teams
Demonstrated ability to deliver scalable, high-performance solutions in various domains
concerns: Limited C++ experience (early-career exposure only, no recent or senior-level work)
No visible experience with industrial automation, IoT, or relevant protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, etc.)
No documented experience with IEC 62443 cybersecurity standards or secure development lifecycle practices
